entries.title: The Boxer's Letter
entries.signal: The "What Good Have I Got from Books?" monologue enters the novel as a letter from the Boxer, recounted aloud on the bushwalk. Reading reframed: not a mirror but a meeting; not chasing a chemical but maintaining the channel.
entries.interference: Must stay recounted speech under exertion, not an essay — the friend is the receiver. Feeds Endgame Movement 2. Trial passage drafted (Bushwalk, Scene A).
entries.note: TMAPO-Writing/notes + drafts/2 Bushwalk/Scene A/The Boxers Letter.md

entries.title: The Endgame Plan
entries.signal: Twelve movements to the end, hung on four chronological pressure-points: rooftop (wound/spark), bedroom (conceptual frame), bushwalk (relation/transmission), ROOT fracture (consequence/rupture). The Boxer dissipates into a distributed archive of unresolved male histories; the courtesan dissolves into composite girlfriends; the book closes where the walk begins.
entries.interference: Introduces Elias Shore and the father; the Australian replacement thread (ocean, white centre, harbour). Guardrails logged in the Bible.

entries.title: The Wound
entries.signal: The ROOT corruption is the spine: the archive begins rewriting itself by resemblance. This is the hidden AI ghost story. Katita leaves over philosophy, not romance — a divergence about what the rewriting means.
entries.interference: Reframes Vaporwave as ROOT's own diagnostic render — Katita appears misrendered inside it. The title gains a beating heart.

entries.title: Revelation
entries.signal: The public log of the Wound: how an idea hidden deep in memory takes months of writing to excavate — the plan you never knew you had.
entries.interference: Companion piece to The Wound, written for the public ideas log.

entries.title: First Page & the Text as Medium
entries.signal: The text moves through constant modulation — letter text, ASCII, diagrammatic text, shifting-format poem text — a stream-of-text flow where the page itself is a medium under pressure.
entries.interference: The progress-page PNGs remain authoritative for exact ASCII layout.

entries.title: Cartoon Maximalism
entries.signal: Cartoon maximalism colliding with daydream consciousness and the ontology gap — the register where the book lets fantasy overload the frame.
entries.interference: Feeds the Vaporwave Bushranger's aesthetic overflow.

entries.title: The Master Plan
entries.signal: A man takes a train from Newcastle to Lake Macquarie to meet his friend for a bushwalk. Everything else is what happens inside his mind on the way: memory, reverie, daydream, fantasy, projection, psychic absorption of the times.
entries.interference: The physical line of the book; the first frequency tuned, not the foundation.

entries.title: Nested Ontology
entries.signal: Six stories, no privileged layer. No single vignette contains the foundation of reality — the reader keeps re-deciding which layer is real, and none of them settle.
entries.interference: The full spectrum: every band lit at once. The dial above is this idea, drawn.

entries.title: Weight
entries.signal: Has the weight of the world shifted to the virtual? The book wrestles with where significance now physically lives — the central thesis.
entries.interference: Runs with the crisis of narration (Byung-Chul Han).

entries.title: Meaning
entries.signal: At meaning's edge, the imagination still flickers.
